com_maxfps.title: Frame rate cap
com_maxfps.summary: Limit how many frames the game runs each second.
com_maxfps.details: Frame timing also feeds movement. CoD2x competitive servers constrain the cap to 125–250 fps; registration defaults are shown separately from server enforcement.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

cg_drawfps.title: Show frame rate
cg_drawfps.summary: Show a frame rate counter while you play.
cg_drawfps.details: The registered modes select the counter display. This does not measure a sustained benchmark.

r_swapinterval.title: Wait for the display
r_swapinterval.details: The source requests a swap interval. Presentation support depends on the graphics driver. Restart the renderer to apply a latched change.

sensitivity.title: Mouse speed
sensitivity.summary: How far your view turns when you move the mouse.
sensitivity.details: A higher number turns farther for the same hand movement. The game's own slider runs from 1 to 30 and ESL's old PunkBuster list also stops at 30; the setting itself accepts 0.01 to 100, and values below 1 are valid. The game also scales your turn with the picture's field of view, so the same number turns a little farther in a wider window and slower while you zoom in. Your mouse's DPI is separate.

in_rawmouse.title: Raw mouse input
in_rawmouse.summary: Use mouse movement from the native input path.
in_rawmouse.details: The macOS input code uses the raw mouse path when enabled. This is a port setting, separate from CoD2x raw-input compatibility controls.

m_filter.title: Smooth mouse movement
m_filter.summary: Average mouse movement across input samples.
m_filter.details: Smoothing changes how individual samples contribute to a turn. It can soften quick changes of direction.

cl_mouseaccel.title: Mouse acceleration
cl_mouseaccel.summary: Turns your view farther the faster you move the mouse; 0 turns this off.
cl_mouseaccel.details: The game adds this number, multiplied by how many mouse counts arrive each millisecond, to your mouse speed. For example 0.04 at 31 counts per millisecond adds 1.24. Zero is the default and keeps every turn the same size however fast your hand moves. zPAM's mouse menu offers 0 and 0.01 to 0.04.

m_pitch.title: Vertical mouse direction
m_pitch.summary: Choose the direction and scale of up-and-down mouse movement.
m_pitch.details: Negative values invert vertical movement. This is a signed scale, so preserve its magnitude when toggling direction.

m_yaw.title: Horizontal mouse scale
m_yaw.details: This multiplies the horizontal mouse input before it changes your view angle.

cl_freelook.title: Look with the mouse
cl_freelook.summary: Let mouse movement control your view.
cl_freelook.details: This is the engine's mouse-look preference. Key actions and game state can also affect look behaviour.

sensitivity_mg.title: Mounted weapon mouse speed
sensitivity_mg.summary: Adjust mouse speed while using a mounted weapon.
sensitivity_mg.details: Available in the CoD2x build. It does not replace your normal mouse speed.

m_rinput.title: CoD2x mouse input
m_rinput.summary: Select the CoD2x input compatibility path.
m_rinput.details: This is distinct from native raw mouse input. The native adapter translates the CoD2x preference; see the source for supported behaviour.

m_rinput_hz.title: Measured mouse input rate
m_rinput_hz.summary: Read the input-rate measurement reported by the game.
m_rinput_hz.details: This diagnostic is read-only. A measured value is not a promised device polling rate.

m_rinput_hz_max.title: Peak measured mouse input rate
m_rinput_hz_max.summary: Read the highest input rate measured by the game.
m_rinput_hz_max.details: This is a read-only peak measurement from the native input statistics. It is not a configured limit or a promised device polling rate.

rate.title: Connection speed
rate.summary: The most game data per second the server may send you.
rate.details: The value is in bytes per second. The game's own Connection menu offers ISDN (5,000) and LAN, cable or DSL (25,000). 25,000 is the highest the game accepts, and servers using CoD2x competitive rules enforce exactly that.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

snaps.title: Updates you receive
snaps.summary: Request how often the server sends game updates.
snaps.details: The server's own frame rate and policy limit what it can send. The current CoD2x port registers 40 and competitive enforcement requires 40.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

cl_maxpackets.title: Updates you send
cl_maxpackets.summary: The most movement updates your game sends the server each second.
cl_maxpackets.details: This is an upper limit, not a promise of that many packets per second. The game's connection-speed step sets it to 30 whenever the connection speed is 5,000 or more, and the in-game Connection menu is expected to run that step. Servers using CoD2x competitive rules enforce 125; zPAM 3 servers on stock CoD2 expect 100.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

cl_packetdup.title: Repeat recent movement
cl_packetdup.summary: Include recent movement commands in outgoing packets.
cl_packetdup.details: The client repeats recent commands to help with lost packets. This does not remove latency.

cg_drawlagometer.title: Show connection graph
cg_drawlagometer.summary: Show the connection timing graph while you play.
cg_drawlagometer.details: The display helps you notice irregular updates. It does not fix the connection.

cl_allowdownload.title: Download server content
cl_allowdownload.summary: Allow downloads needed for the server you join.
cl_allowdownload.details: Servers may require maps or mods that are not installed. The server and redirected-download settings control the available download path.

cl_wwwdownload.title: Redirected downloads
cl_wwwdownload.summary: Allow the server's redirected download path.
cl_wwwdownload.details: Used for HTTP-style redirected downloads when supported. Availability depends on the server.

cl_voice.title: Receive voice chat
cl_voice.details: The client advertises this preference to the server. Voice availability also depends on server settings.

sv_voice.title: Server voice chat
sv_voice.summary: Allow voice communication on a server you host.
sv_voice.details: This is a hosted-server preference, not a local volume control.

r_gamma.title: Brightness
r_gamma.summary: Adjust the brightness of the game picture.
r_gamma.details: The renderer applies this through its gamma path. Display and renderer support affect the result.

r_picmip.title: Texture detail
r_picmip.summary: How sharp surface textures look, from Extra (sharpest) down to Low.
r_picmip.details: 0 is Extra, 1 is High, 2 is Normal and 3 is Low, the same order as the game's own Texture Resolution menu. Sharper textures use more memory. Automatic texture settings can override this unless Choose texture detail yourself is on. Rule sets disagree about level 3, so 0 to 2 is the conservative range.

r_picmip_bump.title: Surface relief detail
r_picmip_bump.summary: How sharp the textures that give surfaces their small bumps look, on the same Extra to Low scale.
r_picmip_bump.details: 0 is Extra, 1 is High, 2 is Normal and 3 is Low, matching the game's Normal Map Resolution menu. It is only used when Choose texture detail yourself is on.

r_picmip_spec.title: Shine texture detail
r_picmip_spec.summary: How sharp the textures that make surfaces shine look, on the same Extra to Low scale.
r_picmip_spec.details: 0 is Extra, 1 is High, 2 is Normal and 3 is Low, matching the game's Specular Map Resolution menu. It is only used when Choose texture detail yourself is on.

r_picmip_manual.title: Choose texture detail yourself
r_picmip_manual.summary: Use your chosen texture detail values.
r_picmip_manual.details: When disabled, the renderer's automatic texture settings can choose the mip levels.

r_lodscale.title: Distant model detail
r_lodscale.summary: Adjust when models use less detailed versions.
r_lodscale.details: Stock protects this setting. The CoD2x registration changes its range and protection; use the facts for your selected build.

r_anisotropy.title: Texture filtering at angles
r_anisotropy.summary: How sharp floors and walls stay when you look along them.
r_anisotropy.details: The number is the filtering level, 2× up to 16×. Higher levels keep textures seen at a shallow angle sharper and can cost performance on some systems. Your graphics hardware caps the level the game can actually use.

r_texturemode.title: Texture filtering
r_texturemode.details: Choose from the registered filtering modes. These are separate from the texture-resolution settings.

r_aasamples.title: Smooth polygon edges
r_aasamples.summary: Choose the renderer's requested sample count.
r_aasamples.details: This is a latched renderer preference. The requested value does not prove that a display or driver accepts it.

r_aspectratio.title: Picture proportions
r_aspectratio.summary: Choose how the game interprets the display's shape.
r_aspectratio.details: The source provides named aspect-ratio choices. This is separate from display resolution.

r_mode.title: Display resolution
r_mode.details: On macOS the choices are built from available display modes. The catalog preserves a dynamic choice list instead of inventing resolutions.

r_displayrefresh.title: Display refresh preference
r_displayrefresh.details: The catalog records the source table. A registered choice does not establish the display's actual refresh rate.

r_fullscreen.title: Full-screen display
r_fullscreen.details: Stock marks this registration read-only. CoD2x changes its flags; native window behaviour is handled by the macOS platform layer.

r_borderless.title: Borderless full screen
r_borderless.summary: Use the native borderless window preference.
r_borderless.details: This is a macOS port registration. It belongs to machine display settings when Config Studio is integrated.

r_multigpu.title: Multiple graphics processors
r_multigpu.details: The legacy renderer registers this preference. Registration does not establish that this Mac has a supported multi-GPU path.

r_rendererpreference.title: Renderer preference
r_rendererpreference.details: These are legacy renderer choices. This catalog does not add a Metal renderer or promise one is available.

r_dlightlimit.title: Dynamic light limit
r_dlightlimit.summary: Limit how many dynamic lights the renderer considers.
r_dlightlimit.details: A lower limit can reduce the number of dynamic lights. The visual result depends on the scene.

r_glow.title: Glow effects
r_glow.details: The effect depends on the materials and rendering path in use.

r_distortion.title: Distortion effects
r_distortion.details: The effect depends on the materials and rendering path in use.

sc_enable.title: Shadows
sc_enable.details: CoD2x competitive mode forces this off. The run-time policy can change the registered type and limits.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

fx_sort.title: Sort visual effects
fx_sort.details: CoD2x competitive mode forces this on and changes its run-time type and limits.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

cg_brass.title: Shell casings
cg_brass.details: Controls client-side casing effects. It does not change the weapon's gameplay.

cg_marks.title: Bullet marks
cg_marks.details: Controls client-side marks. It does not change hit registration.

cg_blood.title: Blood effects
cg_blood.summary: Show blood effects when players are hit.
cg_blood.details: This is a visual preference; server gameplay is separate.

cg_drawcrosshair.title: Show crosshair
cg_drawcrosshair.details: The weapon and game state also determine which crosshair or reticle is drawn.

cg_drawcrosshairnames.title: Show player names
cg_drawcrosshairnames.summary: Show names when you aim at players.
cg_drawcrosshairnames.details: The game decides which player names are eligible to appear.

cg_chatheight.title: Chat lines on screen
cg_chatheight.summary: Choose how many chat lines stay visible.
cg_chatheight.details: The engine keeps a bounded message window. Older messages also expire according to the chat duration.

cg_chattime.title: Chat duration
cg_chattime.summary: Choose how long chat messages remain visible.
cg_chattime.details: The value is in milliseconds. The line limit can remove older messages sooner.

cg_subtitles.title: Subtitles
cg_subtitles.details: Only content with subtitle support can display subtitles.

hud_enable.title: Show the HUD
hud_enable.details: This is an archived, editable preference in the described source. The game state can also determine which HUD elements are drawn.

cg_drawspectatedplayername.title: Spectated player's name
cg_drawspectatedplayername.summary: Show the name of the player you are watching.
cg_drawspectatedplayername.details: Available in the CoD2x client build.

cg_drawcompass.title: Show compass
cg_drawcompass.details: Available in the CoD2x client build. Server rules can affect the match's HUD.

cg_drawradar.title: Radar mode
cg_drawradar.summary: Choose the CoD2x radar display mode.
cg_drawradar.details: The registered modes and source range are shown in Expert. Server rules and game state can constrain the display.

snd_volume.title: Game volume
snd_volume.summary: How loud the game is, from silent to full.
snd_volume.details: The value runs from 0 (silent) to 1 (full volume). The game's own Master Volume slider uses the same scale. This is separate from your Mac's output volume.

mss_q3fs.title: Sound file system
mss_q3fs.summary: Set the sound driver's file-system preference.
mss_q3fs.details: CoD2x competitive mode forces this on and changes its run-time type and limits. It is not a sound-quality preset.
runtimeNotes: CoD2x server policy can change the value, type or limits at run time; registration metadata is not a live ruleset.

mss_3d_provider.title: Sound provider
mss_3d_provider.details: The native backend supplies audio on macOS. A legacy provider name does not install or select a Windows driver.

winvoice_mic_reclevel.title: Microphone recording level
winvoice_mic_reclevel.details: This is an engine input scale, separate from the Mac's microphone settings.

name.title: Your name in game
name.summary: Choose the name other players see.
name.details: The engine supports colour codes. This is shared with the server as player information.

password.title: Server password
password.summary: Set the password used when joining a server.
password.details: Treat this as private. The catalog contains only the source's empty registration default, never a player's saved password.

g_password.title: Hosted server password
g_password.summary: Require a password on a server you host.
g_password.details: This applies to the hosted game. Keep actual passwords in private profiles.

sv_hostname.title: Hosted server name
sv_hostname.summary: Choose the name advertised by a server you host.
sv_hostname.details: This is server information, separate from your player name.

sv_maxclients.title: Player slots
sv_maxclients.summary: Set the maximum player count for a server you host.
sv_maxclients.details: This is a server setting. It does not change the capacity of a remote server.

sv_maxrate.title: Server bandwidth limit
sv_maxrate.summary: Limit the rate allowed by a server you host.
sv_maxrate.details: A client cannot raise a remote server's limit by changing this locally.

sv_maxping.title: Highest allowed join ping
sv_maxping.summary: Set the server's upper ping admission limit.
sv_maxping.details: This applies to a server you host, not your own connection's latency.

sv_minping.title: Lowest allowed join ping
sv_minping.summary: Set the server's lower ping admission limit.
sv_minping.details: This applies to a server you host.

sv_pure.title: Require approved server files
sv_pure.summary: Set the hosted server's pure-file preference.
sv_pure.details: This controls file checks for a server you host. It does not bypass checks on another server.

sv_punkbuster.title: Server PunkBuster preference
sv_punkbuster.summary: Set the legacy server anti-cheat preference.
sv_punkbuster.details: Registration does not prove a working PunkBuster service is available on this native port.

cl_punkbuster.title: Client PunkBuster preference
cl_punkbuster.summary: Read the legacy client anti-cheat preference.
cl_punkbuster.details: Registration does not prove a working PunkBuster service is available on this native port.

g_allowvote.title: Allow voting
g_allowvote.summary: Allow votes on a server you host.
g_allowvote.details: The game and server rules also determine which votes are available.

g_competitive.title: Competitive server rules
g_competitive.summary: Read the CoD2x competitive policy switch.
g_competitive.details: This is server-controlled. It constrains frame rate, networking, shadows, effect sorting, sound file access and the wait command.

g_cod2x.title: Server CoD2x revision
g_cod2x.summary: Read the server's advertised CoD2x revision.
g_cod2x.details: The local host revision stays locked to 0. A registered range does not advertise full CoD2x server support.

com_writeconfig.title: Save game config changes
com_writeconfig.summary: Allow the CoD2x game to write archived settings and binds.
com_writeconfig.details: Config Studio still remains read-only while the engine runs. Turning this off is not permission for concurrent profile editing.

com_errormessage.title: Game error message
com_errormessage.summary: Read the latest game error text.
com_errormessage.details: This is engine-owned status, not a personal preference.

com_errortitle.title: Game error title
com_errortitle.summary: Read the title of the latest game error.

con_restricted.title: Restricted console
con_restricted.details: Protection and server policy are recorded in the registration metadata.

shortversion.title: Game version
shortversion.summary: Read the game version advertised by this build.

version.title: Build information
version.details: The source registers an empty string and fills it during startup. The registration default is not the eventual run-time value.

ui_dedicated.title: Hosted server mode
ui_dedicated.details: The native dedicated-server executable is a separate launch path.

ui_netgametypename.title: Hosted game type name
ui_netgametypename.summary: Read or set the in-game game-type name preference.
ui_netgametypename.details: This is an in-game menu preference; game scripts determine available types.

ui_playerprofilenamenew.title: New in-game profile name
ui_playerprofilenamenew.summary: Set the name used by the in-game profile-creation menu.
ui_playerprofilenamenew.details: Config Studio's own profile operations validate names separately.

ui_browserfriendlyfire.title: Friendly-fire server filter
ui_browserfriendlyfire.summary: Filter the in-game browser by friendly-fire policy.
ui_browserfriendlyfire.details: This is an in-game server-browser preference, separate from launcher browser filters. The registered values are shown in Expert.

ui_browserkillcam.title: Killcam server filter
ui_browserkillcam.summary: Filter the in-game browser by killcam policy.
ui_browserkillcam.details: This is an in-game server-browser preference, separate from launcher browser filters. The registered values are shown in Expert.

ui_browsermod.title: Mod server filter
ui_browsermod.summary: Set the in-game browser mod filter.
ui_browsermod.details: This is an in-game server-browser preference, separate from launcher browser filters. The registered values are shown in Expert.

ui_browsershowdedicated.title: Show dedicated servers
ui_browsershowdedicated.summary: Include dedicated servers in the in-game browser.
ui_browsershowdedicated.details: This is an in-game server-browser preference, separate from launcher browser filters. The registered values are shown in Expert.

ui_browsershowempty.title: Show empty servers
ui_browsershowempty.summary: Include servers with no players in the in-game browser.
ui_browsershowempty.details: This is an in-game server-browser preference, separate from launcher browser filters. The registered values are shown in Expert.

ui_browsershowfull.title: Show full servers
ui_browsershowfull.summary: Include servers with no free slots in the in-game browser.
ui_browsershowfull.details: This is an in-game server-browser preference, separate from launcher browser filters. The registered values are shown in Expert.

ui_browsershownopassword.title: Show servers without passwords
ui_browsershownopassword.summary: Include open servers in the in-game browser.
ui_browsershownopassword.details: This is an in-game server-browser preference, separate from launcher browser filters. The registered values are shown in Expert.

ui_browsershowpassword.title: Show password servers
ui_browsershowpassword.summary: Include password-protected servers in the in-game browser.
ui_browsershowpassword.details: This is an in-game server-browser preference, separate from launcher browser filters. The registered values are shown in Expert.

ui_browsershowpunkbuster.title: PunkBuster server filter
ui_browsershowpunkbuster.summary: Set the legacy anti-cheat filter in the in-game browser.
ui_browsershowpunkbuster.details: This is an in-game server-browser preference, separate from launcher browser filters. The registered values are shown in Expert.

ui_browsershowpure.title: Show pure servers
ui_browsershowpure.summary: Include pure-file servers in the in-game browser.
ui_browsershowpure.details: This is an in-game server-browser preference, separate from launcher browser filters. The registered values are shown in Expert.

snd_khz.title: Sound quality
snd_khz.summary: How detailed the game's sound is, from Low to High.
snd_khz.details: The game opens its sound at 11, 22 or 44 kHz; any other number makes it use 22 kHz and print a warning. Higher gives finer sound at little performance cost. A change applies after the game restarts.

motd.title: Message of the day
motd.details: Restored in the readiness integration source. The registration facts describe this build.

cl_profiletextheight.title: Profile text height
cl_profiletextheight.summary: Set the height used for profile text.
cl_profiletextheight.details: Restored in the readiness integration source. The registration facts describe this build.

sv_ratelimiter.title: Limit server queries
sv_ratelimiter.summary: Limit incoming queries to a server you host.
sv_ratelimiter.details: The CoD2x server query limiter bounds request traffic. This does not change a remote server's policy.

sv_ratelimiterrequestcount.title: Server query count
sv_ratelimiterrequestcount.summary: Read the server query-limiter request counter.
sv_ratelimiterrequestcount.details: This is a read-only diagnostic, not a personal network preference.

sv_ratelimiteruniqueipcount.title: Unique query addresses
sv_ratelimiteruniqueipcount.summary: Read the server query-limiter address counter.
sv_ratelimiteruniqueipcount.details: This is a read-only diagnostic, not a personal network preference.
